_about: Numeric inputs to the six visualizations in src/components/sections/KeyFindingsScroll.svelte. Sections with a `_sql` field are derivable from the Supabase tables at api.formulacode.org once harbor_runs is fully populated; until then values are paper-published. Sections marked `_synthetic: true` are illustrative scatter/Pareto samples — their μ/σ/n parameters seed deterministic Gaussian draws and are visualization choices, not measurements.

vis1_speedup_distribution._description: KDE of speedup vs baseline, agent (red) vs expert (blue). Synthetic samples are clamped to a minimum to keep curves on-domain; means roughly track paper findings.
vis1_speedup_distribution._sql: SELECT agent_name='oracle' AS is_expert, AVG(geomean_speedup) AS mu, STDDEV(geomean_speedup) AS sigma FROM harbor_runs WHERE status='success' GROUP BY 1;

vis2_speedup_by_level._description: Geomean speedup at four aggregation levels (Parameter, Function, Class, Module). Expert holds steady; agent decays with scope.
vis2_speedup_by_level._sql: SELECT AVG((reward_payload->>'agent_advantage_level1')::float) AS l1, AVG((reward_payload->>'agent_advantage_level2')::float) AS l2, AVG((reward_payload->>'agent_advantage_level3')::float) AS l3, AVG((reward_payload->>'agent_advantage_level4')::float) AS l4, agent_name='oracle' AS is_expert FROM harbor_runs WHERE status='success' GROUP BY is_expert;

vis3_advantage_by_strategy._description: Δ speedup (agent − expert) by optimization strategy. Positive = agent wins on that strategy; negative = expert wins.
vis3_advantage_by_strategy._sql: SELECT pr.classification, AVG((hr.reward_payload->>'agent_advantage')::float) AS delta FROM harbor_runs hr JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.owner=hr.owner AND pr.repo=hr.repo AND pr.issue_number=hr.issue_number WHERE hr.status='success' AND hr.agent_name != 'oracle' GROUP BY pr.classification;

vis4_advantage_by_repo_quintile._description: Agent advantage bucketed by repository popularity (GitHub stars, NTILE 5).
vis4_advantage_by_repo_quintile._sql: WITH q AS (SELECT owner, repo, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY stars) AS quintile FROM repositories WHERE stars IS NOT NULL) SELECT q.quintile, AVG((hr.reward_payload->>'agent_advantage')::float) AS advantage FROM harbor_runs hr JOIN q ON q.owner=hr.owner AND q.repo=hr.repo WHERE hr.status='success' AND hr.agent_name != 'oracle' GROUP BY q.quintile ORDER BY q.quintile;

vis5_cost_vs_gain._description: Cost-efficiency scatter (frontier vs open-weight LLMs). Synthetic samples whose cluster means reflect paper findings; variance and n are visualization choices.
vis5_cost_vs_gain._sql_means_only: SELECT (agent_name LIKE '%gpt%' OR agent_name LIKE '%claude%' OR agent_name LIKE '%gemini%') AS is_frontier, AVG((reward_payload->>'cost_usd')::float) AS mu_cost, AVG(geomean_speedup) AS mu_gain FROM harbor_runs WHERE status='success' AND agent_name != 'oracle' GROUP BY 1;

vis6_workload_tradeoff._description: Pareto front of speedup on workload A vs workload B. Synthetic samples illustrating that agents pick points dominated by the expert Pareto front.
vis6_workload_tradeoff._sql_note: Workload-level speedups are in harbor_runs.reward_payload.per_benchmark_speedups (JSON). Computing per-task A-vs-B pairs requires a deterministic workload ordering per task; not yet wired up.
